covered.label: National Rail
covered.detail: Every train calling at Norwich, Cambridge, Ipswich and this region's other stations, from the UK's national real-time feed.

stations: 130 stations and stops: 121 National Rail stations across East Anglia (14 Sep 2026 UK station fill, phase 2a) plus nine Essex stations (Beaulieu Park, Burnham-on-Crouch, Chelmsford, Clacton-on-Sea, Harlow Mill, Harlow Town, Hatfield Peverel, Roydon, Southminster) reassigned in from rest-of-england 15 Sep 2026, resolving a dual claim with london-se-national-rail (docs/jim-brief-essex-to-greater-anglia.md).
